lead_independence.headline: First Border Collies from Palm City hoarding case adopted, Humane Society says
lead_independence.lead: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast has begun placing Border Collies rescued from a Palm City hoarding case into new homes, marking a major milestone in the dogs' recovery. The adoptions come less than a month after Martin County deputies and Animal Services removed 36 Border Collies from a home on Southwest Alligator Street in Palm City in July. The shelter said it has slowly started facilitating adoptions and shared photos from one of the first successful placements.
